string.text: Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
Re-rifling the barrel
Changing the barrel rifling pitch allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Individual fitting of the power supply parts allows you to reduce the likelihood of delays during shooting associated with non-feeding and misalignment of the cartridge.
Refinement of the extractor

Modification of the ejector makes it possible to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.It has a beneficial effect on the reliability of the weapon.
Plastic cover
Replacing the standard wooden lining makes it easier to handle the weapon and also slightly reduces its weight.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows the shooter to fire at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Lightweight magazine
Replacing a standard magazine with a modern analogue made of light alloys allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon.
Chamber adjustment
Careful fitting of parts and minimization of backlash allows for improved sealing and higher shooting accuracy.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the aiming line when firing.
Light alloy parts
Replacing some weapon parts with their modern light-alloy counterparts allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon.
